recognize_zh: 中央嗜中性球的核是兩個大小相近的圓形葉，中間以極細的染色質絲相連，像夾鼻眼鏡（pince-nez），染色質緻密粗塊狀，細胞質顆粒明顯；這是 Pelger-Huët 型雙葉嗜中性球的教科書樣貌。
features: Neutrophil with a symmetric bilobed nucleus: two round lobes connected by a thin filament (pince-nez)
Abundant cytoplasm with conspicuous neutrophilic granules
Background red cells with refractile drying artifact; scattered platelets and a platelet clump
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a symmetric bilobed nucleus composed of two round lobes joined by a thin chromatin filament (pince-nez configuration), with coarse clumped chromatin and well-granulated cytoplasm. Red cells show drying artifact and platelets are present. This represents a Pelger-Huët-type hyposegmented neutrophil; given the reported reactive leukocytosis due to infection, findings are consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huët change, with inherited anomaly and myelodysplasia to be excluded clinically.

ddx.vs: Identical morphology; the inherited form involves nearly all neutrophils lifelong and is present in relatives.
MDS-related pseudo-Pelger cells are usually hypogranular and accompanied by cytopenias and other dysplastic changes.
A band nucleus is a continuous curved band of even width with less condensed chromatin, without two round lobes joined by a filament.
